policy.text: Marigold & Pine pricing policy: target gross margin 45%. Items on the shelf more than 40 days may be discounted to the margin floor without approval. When the sales floor is below 35% occupancy, Concierge may offer a pickup-today incentive of up to $8 below the shipped floor. Any offer below the floor must be approved by the owner (@bosshtw). Never quote above list price. Prefer bundles over discounts when the shopper is price-sensitive.
